article.title: 香港精品生活展結合亞博展場與水上展示
article.title_en: Hong Kong premium lifestyle fair pairs convention halls with waterfront showcases
article.summary: Informa Markets在亞洲國際博覽館舉辦首屆精品生活展，並安排與大嶼山遊艇會聯動。
article.summary_en: Informa Markets staged the first premium lifestyle fair at AsiaWorld-Expo, with a crossover involving Lantau Yacht Club.
highlights: 主辦方把室內展品與水上體驗納入同一活動設計。
highlights_en: The organiser combined indoor displays and waterfront experiences in one event design.
article.why: 高端品牌可把商務洽談和產品體驗分配到不同場景，再用清楚的路線把兩者連起來。
article.why_en: Premium brands can assign meetings and hands-on experiences to different settings, then connect them with a clear visitor route.
article.next_step: 規劃跨場地活動時，分開記錄預約、實際到場及展後跟進。
article.next_step_en: Track reservations, attendance and post-event follow-up separately when planning a multi-venue event.
article.detail: 這次活動的主展場設於亞洲國際博覽館，主辦方亦安排展前節目和遊艇會聯動。跨場地的做法讓品牌可在展廳說明產品，再以實景展示補充體驗。評估同類活動時，宜分清不同場地承擔的工作，並核對交通、入場安排和客戶交接，才能判斷哪一環節值得在下一次沿用。展後可按買家類別整理跟進紀錄。
article.detail_en: AsiaWorld-Expo hosted the main exhibition, with pre-event programming and a yacht-club crossover. This format lets brands explain products indoors and add a real-world experience elsewhere. Evaluate each venue’s role, transport, admission and lead handoffs before repeating the format.After the event, organise follow-up by buyer type.
